assertions.subject: High-grade surface osteosarcomas
assertions.quote: High-grade surface osteosarcomas are, by definition, confined to the bone's surface.

assertions.subject: Secondary osteosarcomas
assertions.quote: Secondary osteosarcomas arise in abnormal bone, most commonly in individuals older than 50 around the knee or hip joint.

assertions.subject: Secondary osteosarcomas
assertions.quote: Secondary osteosarcomas accounts for only about 4% of osteosarcomas.

assertions.subject: Osteosarcoma
assertions.quote: The distinguishing features of osteoid production, variable nuclei with pleomorphism, and numerous mitoses are present.
